makemeahanzi.definition: to link, to join together; to incorporate

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — putting pieces together by hand.
Gives the sound bìng, related to pīn but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: tea; tea leaves; tea plant

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 茶 names a plant, the tea plant, and the drink made from it.

makemeahanzi.definition: only; sole
light, gentle; simple, easy

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — 轻 originally described a light, nimble cart, extended to 'light (weight), gentle.'
工 (gōng) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from qīng.

makemeahanzi.definition: nine

characterDeckComponents.note: A pictograph of a bent arm or elbow; the shape was later borrowed to represent the number 'nine,' unrelated to its original meaning.

makemeahanzi.definition: to strike, to hit, to beat; to attack, to fight

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 擊; 手 provides the meaning

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 (hand) — in the traditional form 擊, 手 contributed the meaning of striking with force, the source of 击's meaning 'to hit, strike.'

makemeahanzi.definition: dragon; symbol of the emperor

characterDeckComponents.note: A drawing of a long, coiling creature with a horned head, representing the mythical Chinese dragon.

makemeahanzi.definition: to bury; to conceal; to plant

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) shows 埋 relates to putting something into the ground.
里 (lǐ) gives a sound distantly related to mái, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to cover, to hide, to protect

etymology.hint: A dish 皿 with a lid 羊

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 here pictures a woven lid or cover.
皿 (dish) sits below, together giving 盖 its meaning 'lid, to cover.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to explain; to loosen; to unfasten, to untie

etymology.hint: To cut 刀 the horns 角 off of an ox 牛; 角 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 角 (horn) — 解 pictures removing a part of an animal.
牛 (ox) — together with a knife cutting between horn and ox, 解 pictures separating something into parts, giving its meaning 'to untie' or 'to explain.'

makemeahanzi.definition: tooth, molar; fang, tusk; serrated
busy, lively; to dispute, to quarrel

etymology.hint: As busy as the market 市 gate 门

characterDeckComponents.note: 门 (a door/gate) — the entrance.
市 (a market) — bustling with people, together giving 闹 its meaning 'noisy, to make a commotion.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to slip, to slide; slippery, polished

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 滑 describes something as slick or slippery, like a wet surface.
骨 (gǔ) is only distantly related in sound to huá — the connection has drifted apart to the point of being barely recognizable.

makemeahanzi.definition: dew; leak; bare, exposed; to reveal, to show

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 (rain) — 露 names a form of moisture related to weather.
路 (lù) gives the sound — an exact match with 露.

makemeahanzi.definition: to caress, to stroke, to gently touch

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 摸 describes touching or feeling something with the hand.
莫 (mò) gives a sound very close to mō, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: board, plank; plate, slab; unnatural, stiff

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — boards and planks like 板 are traditionally made of wood.
反 (fǎn) gives a rhyme close to bǎn, with the initial shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: waves, ripples, breakers; undulations

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 波 refers to waves on water
皮 (pí) gives a sound close to 波's reading bō, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: fat, plump, obese; a fat person

characterDeckComponents.note: Flesh — being fat relates to the body.
Gives the sound bàn, related to pàng but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to know, to recognize, to understand

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 认 relates to recognizing or acknowledging something, often expressed through words.
人 (rén) gives the sound — 认 is pronounced rèn, a close variant of the same sound.

makemeahanzi.definition: to strangle; to tighten

characterDeckComponents.note: 力 (strength) — 勒 relates to tightening or restraining with force.
革 (gé) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading lēi has diverged considerably.

makemeahanzi.definition: to hit, to beat; to smash, to break

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 is the semantic element, tying the character's meaning to the hand.
奏 (zòu) is read identically to this character, "zòu" — a clean phonetic match.

makemeahanzi.definition: wolf

characterDeckComponents.note: 犭 (dog) shows 狼 names a wild animal.
良 (liáng) gives a sound close to láng, differing mainly in the vowel.

makemeahanzi.definition: model, pattern, standard; to copy, to imitate

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — early models and molds were often carved from wood
莫 (mò) gives a sound close to 模's reading mó, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to throw away, to fling, to discard

characterDeckComponents.note: 甩 is visually the character 用 ('to use') with an added stroke pulled outward from the frame — as if something is being flung out of use, giving 甩 its meaning 'to throw, to fling, to discard.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to insert, to stick in; to pierce; to plant

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 插 describes inserting or sticking something in by hand.
臿 (chā) gives the sound — an exact match with 插.

makemeahanzi.definition: to run; ship, transport; fortune, luck

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — relates to 运's meaning 'to move, transport,' and by extension 'fortune,' the movement of one's life.
云 (yún) gives a sound hint — 运 is pronounced yùn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: bright, clear; to explain, to understand, to shed light

etymology.hint: The light of the sun 日 and moon 月

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — combined with 月 (moon), 明 shows the light of both sun and moon, giving the meaning 'bright' or 'clear.'
月 (moon) — together with 日 (sun), the two brightest things in the sky represent brightness and clarity.

meanings: title of an official historian in ancient China

makemeahanzi.definition: history, chronicle, annals

etymology.hint: A hand 乂 using a pen to record a history

characterDeckComponents.note: 乂 (a hand holding a writing tool) — the act of recording events, giving 史 its meaning 'history, chronicle.'

makemeahanzi.definition: maid, servant girl; cute girl

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妮 names a girl or young woman.
尼 (ní) gives the sound — an exact match with 妮, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: victory; to excel, to truimph

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh/body) — historically linked to physical strength and overcoming an opponent
生 (shēng) gives a sound close to 胜's reading shèng, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: box, case; chest, trunk

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — 箱 originally described a bamboo case or chest.
相 (xiāng) gives the sound — an exact match with 箱.

meanings: (TCM) classifier for ingredients of a medicine prescription

makemeahanzi.definition: taste; smell, odor; delicacy

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 味 relates to taste, sensed in the mouth.
未 (wèi) gives the sound — an exact match with 味.

makemeahanzi.definition: to need, to require; must

etymology.hint: Rain 雨 needed for crops to grow

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 (rain) — something crops require to grow, giving 需 its meaning 'to need, require.'

meanings: used in 體己|体己[ti1 ji5]

makemeahanzi.definition: body; group, class; form, style, system

meanings: (bound form) to extend greetings (on a specific occasion)
(used before some verbs to indicate politeness)

makemeahanzi.definition: to bow, to salute; to worship, to pay respects

etymology.hint: Two hands 手 put together in respect

characterDeckComponents.note: 手 (hand), shown twice, side by side — two hands pressed together in a gesture of respect, giving 拜 its meaning 'to bow, to pay respects.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to get married; marriage, wedding

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 婚 relates to marriage, historically centered on the wife.
昏 (hūn) gives the sound — an exact match with 婚.

makemeahanzi.definition: bright, brilliant, radiant, light

characterDeckComponents.note: 亮 is traditionally read as a picture of a lit oil lamp raised on a stand, radiating light — a fitting image for its meaning 'bright, radiant.'

meanings: (transitive or intransitive) to break into pieces

makemeahanzi.definition: to break, to smash; broken, busted

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (rock) — 碎 describes something, often stone-like, broken into pieces.
卒 (zú) is only distantly related in sound to suì — the connection has drifted apart considerably over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: tray, plate, dish; to examine

characterDeckComponents.note: 皿 (dish) — 盘 names a flat dish or tray.
般 (bān) gives a sound distantly related to pán, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: diagram, chart, map, picture; to plan

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 圖; a map of a district's 啚 borders 囗

characterDeckComponents.note: 图 is the simplified form of 圖, which pictured a district's borders 啚 enclosed within a boundary 囗 — an old image of a map, giving 图 its meaning 'picture, chart, map.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to make an order; to draw up an agreement

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 订 relates to arranging something through discussion or agreement.
丁 (dīng) gives a sound distantly related to dìng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: man, husband; worker; those

etymology.hint: A man 大 wearing a coming-of-age hairpin 一

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (a grown man) — the figure being depicted.
一 (a hairpin) — worn across the top of the head to mark a coming-of-age ceremony, giving 夫 its meaning 'man, husband.'

makemeahanzi.definition: expenses, fees; to cost, to spend; wasteful

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell/money) — 费 relates to spending money, fees, and expenses
弗 (fú) gives a loose sound connection to 费's reading fèi

meanings: (bound form) (on restaurant menus) rice noodles 河粉[he2 fen3]

makemeahanzi.definition: river, stream; the Yellow river

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 河 relates to rivers and waterways
可 (kě) gives a sound close to 河's reading hé

makemeahanzi.definition: to take charge of, to control, to manage; officer

etymology.hint: A person speaking orders 口 and raising their arm

characterDeckComponents.note: 司 depicts a person with a raised arm giving orders — an official directing others, giving rise to the meaning 'to manage' or 'to take charge of.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to safeguard, to protect, to defend, to care for

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 保 relates to a person looking after or protecting someone, originally a caretaker holding a child.
呆 (dāi) gives a hint of the sound — 保 is pronounced bǎo, a connection that has shifted over time.

meanings: to slap sb on the face

makemeahanzi.definition: fan; panel; to flap

etymology.hint: A feathered 羽 fan in the shape of a folding door 户

characterDeckComponents.note: 户 (door) pictures the folding shape a hand-fan shares with a door panel.
羽 (feather) contributes to the character's form, since early fans were made of feathers.

makemeahanzi.definition: conscious; to nap, to sleep; to wake up

characterDeckComponents.note: 见 (to see, perceive) — relates to 觉's meaning 'to feel, sense, perceive.'
⺍ is a small graphic element serving as the phonetic hint, though its link to jué's modern sound has faded after centuries of change.

makemeahanzi.definition: to hack, to chop, to cut, to fell

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — early tools for chopping, like axes, were made of stone.
欠 (qiàn) gives a sound distantly related to 砍's reading kǎn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: flat, level, even; peaceful

characterDeckComponents.note: 平 depicts a balance scale drawn level and symmetrical — a simple picture of flatness and equality.
